title: I Will Guard Those Who Love Me
story:
A little girl loved walking home from school with her older brother.

One afternoon, they noticed that the usual path was blocked because some workers were repairing the road.

Her brother immediately chose another route and held her hand as they walked around the construction area.

The girl trusted him because she knew he was watching out for her.

She did not understand everything that was happening around them, but she knew she was safe because someone who cared about her was guiding her.

In our lives, we also encounter situations that we do not fully understand.

There are choices to make, people to deal with, and paths that may seem confusing.

God calls us to love what is good and hate what is evil.

When we choose to walk in His ways, we can trust His protection and care.

He sees dangers that we may not see and knows paths that we may not understand.

Loving God means choosing what honors Him, even when doing so is difficult.

And as we walk with Him, we can rest in the assurance that He watches over those who belong to Him.
life_lesson: Love for God should shape the choices you make. When you reject evil and follow His ways, you can trust Him to watch over and protect you.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for watching over me and caring for my life.

Help me to love what is good and turn away from what is evil.

Give me wisdom to recognize wrong choices and courage to walk in Your ways.

Protect me from dangers I can see and those I cannot see.

Help me trust Your guidance even when I do not understand the path ahead.

May my love for You be reflected in the choices I make every day.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Are there choices in your life where you need to turn away from something that is not pleasing to God?

How can your love for God influence your decisions today?

Are you trusting God to protect and guide you as you follow His ways?
verse: Let those who love the Lord hate evil, for He protects the lives of His faithful ones and delivers them from the hand of the wicked.
